text: Scoping: prompt wording effects on task performance are not simply predicted by word frequency or perplexity, and prompts transfer poorly across datasets and models; a single modal-verb change moved performance up to 17 points in the tested older models (2023, LLaMA/OPT). Do not extrapolate fixed contagion rules from vocabulary frequency. (low confidence)

Repetition priming behaves differently in base LLMs, instruct LLMs and humans; instruction tuning appears to shift models toward more controlled processing, so contagion strength cannot be assumed identical across base and tuned models. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-31)

LLMs reliably repeat contextual content faithfully rather than relying only on internal parameters; RepeatLeakage exploits this to extract system prompts from GPT-Store apps and ChatGPT contexts, and the copy-from-context ability cannot be disabled without hurting core capability. (medium confidence)

Anthropic's official prompting guide states that the formatting style used in a prompt may influence Claude's response style, and advises matching prompt style to desired output style; removing markdown from the prompt can reduce markdown in the output. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-23)

In controlled dative-completion experiments, structurally primed completions show greater lexico-semantic repetition of context, i.e. structural, lexical and semantic alignment reinforce each other during generation (EMNLP 2026 Findings, submitted 2026-09-03). (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-03)
